answer: A forged cluster must fund and maintain every fake identity through each pulse of verification, while honest nodes stake a small saffron-marked reserve refundable on clean epochs. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted reputation slot with slashing: each agent locks a bond tied to a rotating validator set, and admission requires surviving a periodic liveness check synced to the network tide. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities, making mass sybil creation economically irrational versus a single bonded participant. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
